title: WEF ECP Fall 2026 methodology and requisition audit — depth 2
summary: Depth-2 audit confirms conservative pseudonymous-identity handling, adds official requisition R4228, and narrows interpretation of Workday status labels.

data.question: Does the WEF Fall 2026 Reddit applicant-cluster packet preserve conservative SOCMINT identity boundaries, and what official-source frontier should follow?
data.method: Audit the seed and depth-1 StarIntel records, then compare the recruitment graph against current official WEF Workday pages and official Workday recruiting documentation. Use a company jobs surface only for bounded discovery.
data.framework: Pseudonymous-account separation plus official-requisition graph; identity resolution is not a research objective.
data.scope: WEF ECP Fall 2026 seed methodology, official requisitions and candidate-facing Workday status semantics.
findings: The seed correctly keeps public Reddit handles as pseudonymous user entities and explicitly rejects username equality as identity proof.
The seed correctly distinguishes self-reported applicant claims from public-comment observations by participants who did not establish applicant status.
The Reddit/Pinterest nonochan1011 exact-string collision remains separated into distinct user entities with identity_resolved=false and do_not_merge_entities=true.
Official WEF Workday requisition R4228 adds a Greater China Centre for Regions, Trade and Geopolitics role not present in the July 27 depth-1 six-requisition inventory.
The known official inventory is therefore at least seven requisitions: two umbrella cohort requisitions and at least five later role-specific requisitions.

Workday officially documents tenant-configurable external recruiting labels, so strings such as Candidate Assessment and Application Under Review are observations of WEF's candidate-facing portal, not universal Workday stages.
The World Economic Forum company jobs surface exposes two additional New York ECP role titles; their official Workday requisition IDs remain unresolved and must not be guessed.
conclusions: The packet's identity boundary is conservative enough for continued SOCMINT use if user-to-person promotion remains forbidden without independent identity evidence.
The stronger research frontier is the official requisition and recruiting-process graph, not real-world identification of pseudonymous applicants.
Candidate-facing Workday labels should be represented as observed tenant labels with source and timestamp, while any stage interpretation remains an explicit inference.
recommendations: Keep exact-handle reuse as a lexical collision or candidate edge; never merge accounts or create a person solely from username equality.
Require identity_resolved=false and do_not_merge_entities=true on unresolved cross-platform handle collisions.
Separate portal_label_observed from any normalized recruiting-stage interpretation.
Resolve the official Workday IDs for newly listed North America and Latin America ECP roles and enumerate remaining Fall 2026 requisitions.
Do not run additional applicant deanonymization or private-source collection as part of this recursion.
counterarguments: An identical uncommon username can be a useful discovery signal, but it remains insufficient identity evidence by itself.
A candidate-facing status label may correlate with an internal recruiting stage, but Workday's tenant label overrides prevent treating that mapping as universal without WEF-specific documentation.
limitations: The official requisition inventory may still be incomplete.
The two New York role titles were observed on a company jobs discovery surface but their official Workday requisition IDs were not resolved in this pass.
No private Candidate Home records or applicant communications were accessed.
No real-world applicant identities were sought or established.
unresolved: Official Workday requisition IDs and URLs for the North America and Latin America Regional Teams and Government Teams roles.
Complete Fall 2026 ECP requisition count and posting chronology.
Any WEF-specific published mapping from candidate-facing portal labels to internal recruiting stages.

caveats: Applicant statuses remain self-reported unless independently corroborated.
Company-jobs discovery results do not establish official requisition IDs.

title: WEF ECP Fall 2026 methodology audit, depth 2
summary: Completed depth-2 pass that validates conservative pseudonymous-identity handling, adds R4228, and queues an official-role refresh.

classification_rules: A public handle remains a pseudonymous user unless independently supported identity evidence justifies a separate person-resolution review.
Exact username equality across platforms is a discovery signal, not identity proof.
Unresolved cross-platform collisions must remain separate entities and must not be merged.
Applicant status and portal-state claims are self-reported unless independently corroborated.
Candidate-facing Workday labels are tenant-configurable observations and must not be treated as universal stage semantics.
Private, gated, breach, residential, personal-contact, family and face-recognition data are out of scope.

findings.finding: Seed identity guardrails preserve pseudonymous users and reject username-only identity merges.
Official WEF Workday requisition R4228 exists and was absent from the July 27 depth-1 inventory.
Workday allows tenant-specific external recruiting label overrides.
Two additional New York ECP role titles are visible on the WEF company jobs discovery surface; official requisition IDs remain unresolved.

data.method: Repository methodology audit plus current official WEF Workday and Workday documentation review; secondary company-jobs discovery kept unresolved.
